narrativeBlocks.title: Creation has an emotional arc
narrativeBlocks.body: Japanese creation traditions connect divine generation, loss, pollution, and separation rather than producing a tidy origin story.

narrativeBlocks.title: A later retelling
narrativeBlocks.body: Old-World Japan retells Kojiki and Nihongi traditions for English readers. It is useful flavor, but primary references should be added next.

narrativeBlocks.title: What the second source adds
narrativeBlocks.body: The additional corpus record gives a second lens on the same tradition. Compare it with the first source instead of treating either as a complete canon.

narrativeBlocks.title: How to read this evidence
narrativeBlocks.body: Ask what kind of source this is, who translated or organized it, what it can actually prove, and whether another text preserves a different version.

narrativeBlocks.title: Descent changes the world
narrativeBlocks.body: Izanagi’s descent after Izanami turns creation into a story of grief, boundary, and impurity.
